lyrics:
[Intro: two-note guitar figure fades in, synth swells, shuffle beat]

[Verse 1: relaxed, behind the beat]
Good morning, here's your future
It was ordered yesterday
The seat already knows you
And the road already knows the way

[Verse 2: bell keys answer the vocal]
We built a perfect engine
Then we climbed into the back
Windows up, the weather's lovely
On a painted-over track

[Chorus: octave-doubled vocal, wide pad]
Roll on, roll on
Isn't it a lovely feel?
Everybody's singing along
Nobody's at the wheel

[Verse 3: relaxed]
There's a room where they decide things
There's a door without a key
I knocked for half a lifetime
Then I found out the room was me

[Chorus: octave-doubled vocal, wide pad]
Roll on, roll on
Isn't it a lovely feel?
Everybody's singing along
Nobody's at the wheel

[Bridge: warmer, sadder chords, sustained pad]
Say that you'll remember
How the summer didn't last
All the kings of the on-ramp
Getting smaller in the glass

[Guitar Solo: clean, lyrical, short]

[Verse 4: drums drop to hi-hat, then return]
So take your hands out of your pockets
Put a palm against the pane
Somebody ought to steer this
Somebody ought to know its name

[Final Chorus: double chorus, subtle vocoder harmony]
Roll on, roll on
Isn't it a lovely feel?
Everybody's singing along
Nobody's at the wheel
Roll on, roll on
Halfway to tomorrow, signed and sealed
Everybody wants the window
Nobody wants the wheel

[Guitar Solo: overdriven, climbing, full band]

[Outro: backing vocals, two-note guitar figure, fade out]
(Roll on, roll on)
(Roll on, roll on)
